newsitem.title: USA: Madison gains option to buy Franklin-Peck.
newsitem.headline: Madison gains option to buy Franklin-Peck.

text.p: Madison Sports & Entertainment Group Inc said Wednesday it obtained an option to acquire about 70 percent of the capital stock of Franklin-Peck Industries Inc, a Tennessee-based sportswear and casual clothing designer and manufacturer.
The option allows Madison to acquire Franklin-Peck, a private company, in exchange for 200,000 shares of Madison common stock.
Madison shares were trading recently at 2-1/32 each.
The deal is subject to Franklin-Peck completing an initial offering of its securities to an investment group, through which it expects to derive $450,000 in gross proceeds.
